            ### >>> Self_EvolveRec-BLOCK-START: Replay original candidates and suffix plans before changing context or query supervision
            seq, pos, neg, distance = sampler.sample(
                BATCH_SIZE, MAXLEN, negative_count=NEGATIVE_COUNT
            )
            # Candidate construction happens on the original batch. This loss
            # has per-query pools, with no shared candidate columns to shrink.
            original_valid = (seq != 0) & (pos != 0) & (neg > 0).all(axis=-1)
            retained = np.zeros_like(seq, dtype=bool)
            for row in range(seq.shape[0]):
                positions = np.flatnonzero(seq[row])
                n = positions.size
                if n == 0:
                    continue
                k = n
                if crop_rng.random() < 0.5:
                    k = int(crop_rng.integers((n + 1) // 2, n + 1))
                retained[row, positions[-k:]] = True
                histogram = exposure["retained_length_histogram"]
                histogram[str(k)] = histogram.get(str(k), 0) + 1

            query_mask = original_valid.copy()
            if STUDY_CONDITION != "A":
                query_mask &= retained
            inputs = seq.copy()
            if STUDY_CONDITION == "C":
                inputs[(seq != 0) & ~retained] = 0
            if WEIGHTING == "window":
                targets = (seq != 0) & (pos != 0)
                distance = np.cumsum(targets[:, ::-1], axis=1)[:, ::-1] - targets
            # Preserve original ages, candidate multiplicities and target IDs.
            # The loss keeps the inherited within-row normalization, followed
            # by an equal mean over eligible rows. B's prefix stays attached.
            exposure["scheduled_batches"] += 1
            exposure["rows"] += int(seq.shape[0])
            exposure["original_input_tokens"] += int(np.count_nonzero(seq))
            exposure["training_input_tokens"] += int(np.count_nonzero(inputs))
            exposure["original_valid_targets"] += int(original_valid.sum())
            exposure["supervised_targets"] += int(query_mask.sum())
            exposure["planned_changed_rows"] += int(
                ((seq != 0) & ~retained).any(axis=1).sum()
            )
            exposure["actual_changed_rows"] += int((inputs != seq).any(axis=1).sum())
            seq_t = torch.tensor(inputs, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
            pos_t = torch.tensor(pos, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
            neg_t = torch.tensor(neg, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
            distance_t = torch.tensor(distance, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
            query_t = torch.tensor(query_mask, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
            loss = bpr_sequence_loss(

                distance=distance_t,

                positional=POSITIONAL_WEIGHTING,
                query_mask=query_t,
            )
